description: React component for a featured news carousel displaying top stories with navigation controls, auto-advancement, and visual indicators.

methods.name: FeaturedCarousel()
methods.description: React functional component displaying a carousel of featured news stories with navigation buttons and auto-slide feature.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the carousel to the next story, looping to the start if at the end.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the carousel to the previous story, looping to the end if at the start.
